eps.title: Season preview: tiers, dark horses and a bold call

lines: Alright alright alright. Big Ced, how we feeling?
Season 2031 is here and I have opinions about all thirty-two of these programs.
Westgate Baptist starts at No. 1. I want to see them do it on a Saturday in November before I hand them anything.
Tier one: WGT, BER, CLE. Everybody else is chasing.
My dark horse is Liberty Baptist. Write it down.
The team I'm most worried about? Southwest Baptist. Too many questions up front.
C|Hot take: Westgate Baptist is a FRAUD. Paper tiger. Beat somebody.
That is going to age terribly and I cannot wait.
Coach Paul Coyle and Averyville Baptist at 0-0, No. 14 in the country.
I go back and forth on them every week, which tells you something.
Next up: Liberty Baptist. That's a trap game if I've ever seen one.
@Outlaws4Life asks: "Who has the best fan base in the league? Asking for a friend. The friend is me. I'm a Outlaws fan."
Whoever travels best to a road game in the rain. That's the test.
WGT at ELL: Westgate Baptist. Comfortably.
BER at LHI: Berean Baptist. Slight lean.
HAL at CLE: Cleveland Baptist. Bank it.
ARB at SCB: Arden Road Baptist. Easy.
RSB at SWB: Southwest Baptist. Not overthinking it.
Season record: 0-0.
R. Achebe of Ellicott Baptist on Westgate Baptist: "We're going to their place and we're going to make it quiet."
I would not have said that out loud. But here we are.
That is a wrap. Rate, review, and stop texting me about the poll. See you Saturday.
C|Ced out. Somebody check on the panic meter.
